responsibility: Implements the detailed rendering of quoted source lines, carets, ranges, labels, fix-it hints, escaping, margins, and multibyte-aware column layout for diagnostics. This file is the core of diagnostic_show_locus-style output: it consumes rich_location data, file_cache content, source_printing_options, column policy, and optional label effects, and produces annotated text or HTML representations of relevant source code with correct handling of tabs, UTF-8 display width, fix-it insert/delete lines, and line-number/ruler presentation.
